notablePrerequisites: Mark of Eviction attached to Wormfang Manta.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mark of Eviction triggers, returning itself and Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Cast Mark of Eviction by paying {U}, targeting Wormfang Manta.
Repeat.
